name: Cinders of Chaos
author: Cinders of Chaos
description: The Void layout re-coloured to the Cinders of Chaos client: iron blacks, gold trim and crimson. A child theme: the page shell comes from Void, the colours, frames, art, home page and class pages from here. Its stylesheets are generated by website/tools/recolor_layout.py when the site is installed.

options.label: Favicon
options.help: The browser tab icon (32 px). The rest of the icon set, favicon.ico, the web manifest and the link preview image are generated (website/README.md, SEO and social previews).

options.label: Logo image
options.help: Shown in the header and footer. Wide transparent PNG.

options.label: Page background image
options.help: Sits behind the whole site, under the dark tint.

options.label: Header video URL
options.help: Optional looping .mp4 in the header band.

options.label: Discord invite URL
options.help: Adds a Discord button to the header, the Follow us panel and the footer. Leave empty to hide it.

options.label: Footer line
options.default: A dark fantasy world, broken and still bleeding.
options.help: Shown in the footer, above the copyright.
